complexity_justification: Reserving swap slots in batches per CPU eliminates repeated spinlock acquisitions under concurrent allocation, decreasing locking overhead with minimal state additions to percpu_swap_cluster.
frontier_reason: First validated per-CPU batched swap slot allocation and refill implementation for mm/swapfile.c with full 17-gate correctness proof and calibrated screening.

reason: Candidate achieves FAST_PASS with measured latency reductions (-1.4% sequential mean on disk, -2.5% sequential mean on zram, -3.3% sequential p99 on zram) and passes all scored guardrails across all 4 screening pairs.
learning_value: Demonstrates that batched per-CPU swap slot reservation in mm/swapfile.c successfully amortizes spinlock overhead and passes all 17 correctness gates including clean swapoff draining. However, the measured net speedup (-2.8%) remains within the calibrated noise floor (+/-6.2%), indicating that single-slot cluster lock contention is only a secondary contributor to swap latency under modest concurrency.
